name: Cinematic UI
description: A unified cinematic Jellyfin Web customization with a profile-forward login screen, Plex-inspired theme, and rotating library-driven home hero.
overview: Cinematic login and home experience for Jellyfin Web

versions.changelog: Fixes the crowded homepage hero on phones and tablets, including the Jellyfin Android app. Carousel indicators wrap below Play and More Info without a horizontal scrollbar. Rotation and arrow controls have separate space, actions wrap on narrow screens, and the hero grows for long titles and larger text. Preserves existing navigation, playback, carousel settings, and desktop layout.

Compact profile and user menu with native account controls and an Appearance opt-out. Cancels stale hero data/artwork after account or server changes, scopes repeat history and Play intent to each account/server, and prevents foreign-origin credentials being used. Explicit library names never fall back to unrelated libraries; blank selection uses available movie/TV views. Missing views, failed enumeration, or all excluded titles retain native Home without repeated requests.

Plex-style title details with smaller posters, clear gold Play actions, subdued metadata/backdrop, shared desktop library navigation, and responsive season episode thumbnails. Preserves native detail/episode actions and lazy artwork; adds a default-enabled Appearance opt-out and conservative TV/unknown-structure fallbacks. Fixes remaining blue player slider thumbs, volume/settings bars and React accents, and prevents the volume slider collapsing. Honors the configured accent color and global-theme opt-out.

Plex-inspired Jellyfin Web video player: slim timeline, compact bottom controls, footer title, centered transport on wide screens, and responsive controls on smaller screens. Retains native playback, seeking, volume, audio/subtitle/settings menus, fullscreen, episode transitions, and control visibility. Adds a default-enabled Appearance opt-out and preserves legacy settings. Fixes the global theme overriding Jellyfin's transparent playback background. TV and unrecognized player structures retain their native layout.

Plex-inspired library layout for Jellyfin 12.1: desktop sidebar using existing profile-visible navigation, active library heading, a search pill, smaller spaced posters, left-aligned transparent captions, and quieter toolbar and count badges. Smaller screens retain native navigation. Filter, sort, grid/list view, details, and playback remain Jellyfin controls. Adds an appearance opt-out while preserving existing settings and the catalog update pipeline.

UI hardening: preserve keyboard focus on hero indicators, expose the current title to assistive technology, add explicit Pause/Resume rotation, pause for keyboard focus and reduced motion, enlarge and scroll indicator hit areas, and retain artwork during rapid title changes. Support Jellyfin 12.1 React headers for login branding and cosmetic navigation hiding, and keep profile and recovery controls scrollable on small screens. Retains the catalog update pipeline, plugin identity, and existing settings.

Repository-management release: verified catalog installation and normal Jellyfin Update Plugins upgrades from v0.1.5, a stable cumulative GitHub manifest, immutable runtime packages, retained configuration, and safe TrueNAS rollback backups. Preserves the original v0.1.5 login, theme, and hero assets; no new UI features.

Clarifies Jellyfin library permissions versus cosmetic navigation hiding, adds generic optional navigation hiding by library name, adds login header-branding control, adds hero title-keyword exclusions and optional played-title filtering, improves hero rotation lifecycle, and adds GitHub repository-release automation assets.
